options.name: command
options.description: C(uci) command to execute. The default is V(set) if O(value) is passed, otherwise the default is V(get). The V(get), V(export), and V(show) states should be factored out of this module into an C(_info) module.

options.name: config
options.description: Config part of the O(key). If not specified, extracted from O(key).

options.name: find
options.description: Value(s) to match sections against. Option value to find if O(option) is set. May be list. Dict of options/values if O(option) is not set. Values may be list. Lists are compared in order. Required when O(command=find) or O(command=section).

options.name: keep_keys
options.description: Space separated list or list of keys not in O(value) or O(find) to keep when O(replace=yes).

options.name: key
options.description: The C(uci) key to operate on. Takes precedence over O(config), O(section) and O(option). If not specified, constructed as O(config).O(section).O(option).

options.name: merge
options.description: Whether to merge or replace when O(command=import).

options.name: name
options.description: New name when O(command=rename) or O(command=add). Desired name when O(command=section). If a matching section is found it is renamed, if not it is created with that name.

options.name: option
options.description: Option part of the O(key). If not specified, extracted from O(key).

options.name: replace
options.description: When O(command=set) or O(command=section), whether to delete all options not mentioned in O(keep_keys), O(value) or find when O(set_find=true).

options.name: section
options.description: Section part of the O(key). If not specified, extracted from O(key).

options.name: set_find
options.description: When O(command=section) whether to set the options used to search a matching section in the newly created section when no match was found.

options.name: type
options.description: Section type for O(command=section), O(command=find) and O(command=add). If not specified, defaults to the value of O(section).

options.name: unique
options.description: When O(command=add_list), whether to add the value if it is already contained in the list.
